parties: A reference under section 113 read with order XLVI rule 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
full_judgment: “The legislature is presumed to have been aware of the existing law and there is a presumption that the legislature does not intend to make a change in the existing law beyond what is expressly provided or which follows by necessary implication from the language of the statute in question. A statute is prima facie to be construed as changing the law to no greater extent that its words or necessary intendment requires.”
